name: Katymár (Hungary)
description: A vertical cream banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Katymár (a shield with a chequered field, a sun and a figure of the Virgin) between the name KATYMÁR above and 1388 below in black.
history: The arms and flag of Katymár were inaugurated in 1993. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
